text:
elaine (AE): Hey team — trying to close a POC with Meridian Health. They signed the NDA but legal wants SOC2+ISO artifacts, a signed pen-test letter, and confirmation of staging IPs for their scanner. Asking for timeline and whether pen-test letter can be the generic template or needs company letterhead. Any blockers for Dedicated POC pricing if we confirm staging CIDRs?

mark (Security): @elaine we can provide SOC2 type II report excerpt and ISO summary. Pen-test letter: usually needs to be on vendor letterhead and signed by the 3rd-party tester or our security lead referencing the tester. We shouldn't backdate. :warning:

devon (Solutions): Quick Q — do they need the full control narrative or just the artifact index? Meridian said "everything that proves controls exist" which is vague. If it's just for a POC eval, an artifact index + a few exported logs usually suffices.

elaine (AE): They asked for specific items: list of AWS account IDs for staging, network diagram, KMS attestation, and a short pen-test attestation for scope limited to staging. Also asking if Dedicated pricing changes with pen-test involvement/extra isolation.

priya (Infra): For staging CIDRs we can give a short-lived allowlist. Sample: `54.210.0.0/16, 3.80.0.0/14` — but we'll use pre-signed ephemeral IPs if they want scheduled scans. Need start/end window and target hostname.

mark (Security): Pen-test attestation snippet we can provide: ```This letter attests that Redwood Inference engaged AcmeSecurity LLC to perform an external penetration test against the scoped staging environment on YYYY-MM-DD. No critical issues affecting PII handling were identified. Signed, Redwood Security Lead.``` Replace with actual dates and sign-off.

devon (Solutions): On the Dedicated pricing side: dedicated pools + extra isolation (single-tenant network) adds a fixed premium. Pen-test doesn't change pricing unless they require a dedicated on-prem connector or extra audit retention. I can pull the estimate if you confirm isolation level.

elaine (AE): Customer also wants an ETA for documentation — legal wants artifacts in 3 business days. Is that realistic?

mark (Security): 3 days is tight. SOC2/ISO extracts we have, but getting a signed pen-test letter in 3 days depends on the 3rd party. We can provide a draft attestation from us within 24h and escalate for signature.

priya (Infra): If they accept ephemeral allowlist windows we can schedule scanning within 48h. Need the scan IPs and expected traffic pattern (UDP/TCP/port list).

devon (Solutions): Actionables: 1) @mark to drop draft pen-test attestation and artifact index. 2) @priya to confirm possible CIDR windows + runbook for scanner. 3) @elaine to confirm what Meridian actually needs (full reports vs index). I can prepare a Dedicated quote placeholder for isolation+retainer.

mark (Security): Draft attestation and artifact index incoming in ~4 hours. I'll include a short note about data residency and KMS flow.

elaine (AE): awesome — Meridian asked whether we can redact vulnerability details in the pen-test letter. Is that ok?

mark (Security): Redacting low/med vuln details is OK for public-facing summaries, but customer legal typically wants full findings under an NDA. For a POC we can provide a high-level summary and offer full findings in the dataroom.

priya (Infra): Also FYI: if they want logs retained for audit, extra retention affects cost. Call that out in the quote.

elaine (AE): Thanks — I'll tell them we can get a draft attestation + artifact index in 24h, CIDR window in 48h, and Dedicated pricing placeholder same day as the draft quote. Will ping back with exact scan window. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: deploy-check: no outstanding compliance blockers for staging; documented controls: SSAE-18 mapping, KMS key rotation logs present.
